title: Real DEM + PLATEAU buildings (fetch + scene env-var override)

env_overrides.GENEGIS_COPC_PATH: replaces the fixture COPC in the scene acceptance path
env_overrides.GENEGIS_DEM_BBOX: restricts the GSI DEM fetch to a district-level subset
env_overrides.note: digests must be re-declared so receipts stay fail-closed

gsi_dem.source: 国土地理院 標高タイル DEM5A (5m), text format
gsi_dem.license: 国土地理院コンテンツ利用規約（政府標準利用規約準拠）

plateau.source: PLATEAU 名古屋市 3D都市モデル 2022 (Project PLATEAU, MLIT)

verification.scene: the gpu_scene_acceptance binary resolves GENEGIS_COPC_PATH / GENEGIS_BUILDINGS_PATH before the fixture manifest
verification.fail_closed: real scene assets require re-declared copc/lod1 digests; the committed Phase 14 M1 receipt still verifies against the committed fixtures
